== This article contradicts itself, but I don't know how to fix it... ==

In the top few paragraphs affinities are described as having to do with the five elements of the One Power: Air, Fire, Earth, Water and Spirit. Yet in the very last paragraph, Egwene is described as having an affinity for metals, which is not one of the five. Perhaps we could explain that metal affinity is an "earthen" affinity?
